text:
R416 — External expert transfer control and sparse decode implementations
Accessed: 2026-10-13
Scope: Arc 10 GiB, 128 GiB RAM, measured H2D ceiling ~6.45 GB/s; 512 experts, 8 routed, effective NT=1. Current source-owned HostUSM expert payload: reported ~50.29 GB/run. Read-only external survey; no Strata performance claims.

Decision

The most relevant implementation pattern is route-first active-set staging: after routing, gather selected expert blobs into bounded compact GPU slots, maintain expert-ID-to-slot mapping, then execute the existing expert math against that mapping. If 50.29 GB represents all 512 experts across the same 48-layer pass, equal-sized byte arithmetic gives 50.29×8/512 = 0.786 GB selected payload. This is only an upper-bound traffic estimate, not measured speedup; scattered reads, CPU packing, copy submissions, and kernel-layout constraints may erase savings. R414's ms_experts_host remains the decision gate because it combines source fetch with completed copies and does not isolate PCIe.

1. Closest model: HaberstrohSystems Qwen3.8 SGLang patch
https://github.com/HaberstrohSystems/qwen3.8-flash-next-24gb-sglang (README/docs/WRITEUP.md, accessed 2026-10-13). It describes Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 24 GB, 32 GB RAM, AutoRound 2-bit group-128 at 2.572 bpw. Its cumulative table reports stock CPU offload 2.24 tok/s (26 GB PCIe/token), early patch base 15.5 tok/s after replacing whole-layer offload with ExpertStreamer, later address-table/in-place batch-1 GEMV 21.8 tok/s, and subsequent graph/cache/placement steps reaching 56 tok/s. Do not attribute later outcomes to ExpertStreamer alone. This is the closest architecture/model, but CUDA/Triton, quantization, GPU, and RAM differ. Concrete candidate: inspect route-first streaming and reproduce only compact staging plus expert-to-slot mapping, preserving Strata weight bytes and compute kernels. Require exact per-layer output comparison; no Arc speedup is established.

2. Active-set gather and remap: leoustc/vllm-moe
https://github.com/leoustc/vllm-moe (README/case description, accessed 2026-10-13). Its passive-offload description waits for routing, gathers active expert weights into compact slots, remaps selected IDs, computes, then frees slots; over-capacity uses waves. Its cited benchmark is a separate prefetch mode: Gemma4-26B-A4B-it, A100 40 GB, 16 prompts, request rate 8/concurrency 16, output 55.32 tok/s and TPOT 240.59 ms. It does not benchmark the passive path or Strata's workload. For Strata, 8 arbitrary experts are not contiguous in source, so a single source-span copy can overfetch most of a layer. Compare 8 copies into fixed slots against CPU packing into bounded pinned slab plus one copy per layer; record gather and DMA time separately. Ensure exact extents, padding, and mapping.

3. Device-side map control: pedrohedro/vllm-expert-offload
https://github.com/pedrohedro/vllm-expert-offload (moe_cache_policies.md, accessed 2026-10-13). Describes pinned host weights, fixed per-layer GPU scratch slots, persistent GPU int32 expert-to-slot map updated in place, and vectorized remapping to avoid CPU map work/H2D map upload. It documents eager-mode and CUDA-graph incompatibility; no comparable benchmark found. Borrow the control-plane idea only; this does not reduce expert weight bytes.

4. Transfer controller: vLLM-HUST Ascend LatchMoE
https://github.com/vLLM-HUST/vllm-ascend-hust-LatchMoE (accessed 2026-10-13). Describes stable-address NPU slots, pinned host storage, staging on transfer stream outside ACLGraph, bounded/double buffers, byte-aware wave order, and multi-wave/full-layer overflow fallback. Ascend APIs and performance do not transfer to Arc. Reusable idea: explicit byte budget and fallback if active set exceeds slots. Strata's current one-layer cache drains before reuse; do not assume overlap, and preserve DMA source lifetime and checked compute retirement.

5. CPU sparse decode screen: HiNa-MoE
https://lukebest.github.io/papers/hina-moe-cpu-amx-moe-inference (dated 2026-10-07; accessed 2026-10-13). Reports dual Xeon Gold 6430 + RTX A6000, Mixtral-8x7B, batch-1 128/128 decode, AMX CPU expert path, up to 2.09× endpoint speed vs KTransformers; methods include NUMA page interleave and transforming intermediates for small matrix-matrix work. Ryzen 5 5600X has no AMX; IQ2/IQ3 row formats differ and NT=1 prevents token batching. No direct kernel port. Investigate NUMA only if measurements establish host-memory bottleneck.

6. Negative applicability evidence
- SGLang CPU OffloaderV2 issue #32507: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/32507 (opened 2026-07-27; accessed 2026-10-13). No-copy specialization for 32/64/72 local experts fails at N=16; issue suggests pinned-H2D fallback. Validate shape/count fallback rather than copy the specialization.
- Intel llm-scaler: https://github.com/intel/llm-scaler (accessed 2026-10-13). Intel GPU/vLLM INT4/FP8/MXFP4 comparator; reviewed material does not establish exact Strata-format host gathering or a Zen3 AVX2 sparse CPU kernel.
- xj85770/moe-offload-decode: https://github.com/xj85770/moe-offload-decode (accessed 2026-10-13) analytically scales a GLM-5.2 CPU expert-byte component under top-k reduction. That changes routing semantics and is unsuitable for exact output; useful only as an attribution method.

R414 handoff

First use ordinary ms_experts_host to decide whether transfer/source fetch deserves intervention. If so, build a decoder-independent fixture with distinct byte patterns for all 512 experts and variable native extents; stage boundary and arbitrary IDs; verify GPU bytes, padding, map, kernel offsets, and no source/slab/slot reuse before checked DMA and compute retirement. Then compare full-layer versus staged-subset outputs for identical routes/activations, preserving all expert contributions and full head row. Retain cancellation/error drains and GPU/RAM/pinned/max-allocation admission. Do not change quantization, router, or arithmetic. External figures above are attributed only to their stated setup; no Strata builds/tests/GPU runs/source edits or cleanup were done.
qualification: Source-only report. Main executed evidence is separate; R412 audited parent only, superseded for actual4K source by R413. R413 says five but explicitly lists six changed files.
